 JUDGMENT
2. Matter is listed for further orders regarding non- compliance of office objections for number of times.
3. It is seen that appeal was filed in year 2023.
Though sufficient opportunities were granted for compliance of office objections, even till date, office objections are not complied.
This would indicate that appellant is not diligent in prosecuting appeal.
Hence, appeal is dismissed for non-prosecution.
